contentHtml:
Blizzard has reduced the maximum number of dungeons players can run per hour in WoW: Forever.

In yesterday's hotfixes, Blizzard announced they have reduced the maximum number of dungeons to five per hour. WoW: Forever launched with a 10 dungeon lockout per hour, and this nerf makes it match the original Classic Era lockout. It's unclear if the increase to 10 dungeons per hour was intentional or a side effect of using the Modern client.

Either way, this change shouldn't affect anyone doing a full dungeon clear for leveling or gear. Dungeons in WoW: Forever typically take at least 30 minutes to fully clear and players doing this will never hit the cap. For players farming specific things, this change may affect them depending on the run length. With 5 dungeons an hour, if a run takes less than 12 minutes, then you will run into issues with the new cap.

Blizzard may be trying to curb the amount of gold entering the economy from raw gold farms. Soloing any dungeon, regardless of level, will provide a decent amount of Gold from raw vendored drops. One of the most common ways to solo farm trash is to abuse enemy pathing issues. While players can jump, mobs typically can't. There are certain locations where players can jump up and down in less than a second, which can cause a 10+ second detour from mobs. This can allow players to solo what was desinged for multiple players.



As you can see, the new Krol'dok Stronghold farm can be done in about 5 minutes. These mobs are likely dropping intended loot, unlike the Blackmaw Hold Farm, which also benefited from quick clears. Both farms can be completed quickly and players will now run into dungeon lockout issues if they want to do farms like these. More farming methods are going to be found going forward, and this change may be Blizzard's way of preventing any crazy amount of farming in dungeons going forward.

Alcaz Prison


Alcaz Prison is on Alcaz Island, a lone island in the northeast part of Dustwallow Marsh. This dungeon is on the shorter side and will probably only take about 30 minutes.

This secret quest offers a 25 gold reward and only appears when a boss is skipped. After pikcing up the quest, you can kill him for his quest objective.

Hotfixes

November 20, 2026

Classes
  • Rogue

      • Blade Flurry will now correctly cause Shank’s damage to hit an additional target.

contentHtml:
The stats for the crafted versions of Tier Set gear from the first raid tier have been revealed in a hotfix to Forever!
More Information:
Blizzard has confirmed with Wowhead that these items stats have been revealed intentionally and can be seen in game directly, as item obfuscation doesn't apply to items from vendors and recipes. They have also confirmed that the set bonuses are placeholder and will be updated in the future.
WoW: Forever's first raiding tier releases on December 9th with a global launch. While Blizzard has intentionally not revealed much about the bosses or the loot they drop, they have now revealed item stats for the crafted tier pieces. We know from a Crix interview that tier pieces will drop across all three raids, but what if you don't have a 40-man, or just get unlucky? Crafted Tier Set pieces could be the solution. These crafted pieces all have a unique quality, "Artisan's Tier (1)." This seems to indicate that you can craft exactly one piece of raid tier, which might give some bad luck protection to help you reach that next set bonus.

These items are all crafted and our database has been updated with all these recipes (e.g. Plans: Justice Pauldrons) if you want to see the crafting cost or profession requirements. On the beta, these were purchased from Aisarra Nightmeadow for Malleable Essence of Nature, but in the most recent Forever build, that vendor no longer offers the recipes. We don't know if they'll be added back at a later time, or if there will be new ways to earn them once the raids go live.

title.en: Layer Swap and Other Targeted Layering Addons Will Be Disabled Soon in WoW: Forever
title.es: El cambio de capa y otros complementos de capas específicas se desactivarán pronto en WoW: Forever

summary.en: Layer Swap and Other Targeted Layering Addons Will Be Disabled Soon in WoW: Forever...
summary.es: El cambio de capa y otros complementos de capas específicas se desactivarán pronto en WoW: Forever...

contentHtml:
Targeted Layering Addons will no longer work in an upcoming hotfix for WoW: Forever, as various API calls that show a realm ID will be obfuscated soon.

One popular addon on CurseForge right now is Layer Swap, an addon that helps facilitate layer hopping. Players use layer hopping for many reasons, but a main one is to find a new phase when the current one has competition. It can also help when some players are bugged on certain layers. With an addon like Layer Swap, players can see how many layers there could be, whether they've already been to a layer, and directly phase into the layer they want.


Image Credit: Layer Swap


An addon like Layer Swap does two things:
  1. Facilitates invites to a new layer more easily by automating communication.
  2. Allows the tracking and targeting of specific layers.
Blizzard has been communicating addon changes to authors through the WoWUIDev Discord since the Midnight expansion and with Forever now on the modern architetcture, they have started communicating updates there as well. With an announcement in the WoWUIDev Discord, they announced some changes to the API:
Blizzard via WoWUIDev Discord said:
Midnight 12.1.7 PTR Changes 6

Addon Security
  • The realm ID in creature, vehicle, pet and game object GUIDs is now obfuscated along with the server ID and spawn ID.
    • This will also apply to Forever in an upcoming 1.60.1 hotfix.
Forever 1.60.1 Live Update 2

Miscellaneous
  • APIs that return realm names or IDs now instead return an empty string or zero in-place of those values.
    • This includes - but is not limited to - GetRealmName, GetRealmID, and C_BattleNet APIs whose game account returns would include realm information.
    • This change only applies to WoW Forever.
These changes will hit layer swap addons by removing methods of determining the "realm ID". As mentioned in the description of the Layer Swap addon:
Layer Swap Addon said:
A player changes layer by joining a group whose leader stands on another layer. A host is somebody who invites whoever asks. This file is the host, the reading of the player's own layer from creature GUIDs, the request for a swap, and the small panel on top of them. What happens is written to SavedVariables so it can be read from disk after a /reload.
Layer Swap lists creature GUIDs as how they determine which layer a player is currently on and can then use this to track the different layers. With the removal of this, Layer Swap and other addons will not be able to compare and contrast which layer players are on.

This change won't prevent layer swapping in the future, but the targeted layer swapping should no longer be possible unless another workaround is found. Players will have to jump randomly between layers until they find what they're looking for, and there's no guarantee that a different person will be on a different layer.

Blizzard has recapped some of the biggest events in WoW this week, which includes a podcast on WoW: Forever class design, details on Patch 12.1.7, the WoW Anniversary event, and more!

From the WoW: Forever Podcast's focus on class design to the 1 December arrival of Midnight: Echoes of the Worldcore, Talebound's macabre rewards, Mythic 2/6 gear in the Labyrinth of Kino'jan, and the World of Warcraft 22nd Anniversary Celebration, this week's news is packed with fresh stories, new challenges, and festive adventures across Azeroth.

WoW: Forever Podcast – Catching up on Classes

Join WoW: Forever Podcast host Countdown To Classic for a conversation with Senior Game Designer Aidan Moon and Principal Game Designer Kris Zierhut as they take careful aim on class design.

Watch now to bring class design into focus.

Midnight: Echoes of the Worldcore Arrives on 1 December


Azeroth’s history is waiting beneath the Coreway. Return to Dornogal, face the Storyteller’s macabre tales in Talebound, and join Li Li Stormstout for a Lorewalk through the stories that shaped Azeroth in Midnight: Echoes of the Worldcore.

When : Arrives 1 December (with regional maintenance)

The Worldcore is calling, and we can't wait to meet you in Dornogal.

Talebound’s Twisted Tales and Deadly Fates Arrive 1 December


Step into the macabre world of Talebound in a PvE action RPG game mode where you become part of the dark chronicles of a mysterious Storyteller, chillingly brought to life, and where danger is written on every page.

Whether you venture alone or with friends, Talebound invites you to explore themed tales across Normal, Veteran, and Heroic difficulties, filled with enemies, bosses, puzzles, treasure, relics, and rewards as you confront the terrors waiting beyond Quillgrave.

Macabre Rewards Await in Talebound


Madness stirs in Talebound’s darkest stories, and a telling tale isn’t without its just reward. Outfit yourself with a dark trove of cosmetic rewards using Bound Silver, a Warband-bound currency earned by completing quests, achievements, and progress in the Tales of the Storyteller.

Do you think you can face the Storyteller’s macabre machinations? Go solo or gather your allies to stand steadfast against Talebound's terrifying tales and be rewarded for your efforts.

Get Mythic 2/6 Gear in Labyrinth of Kindo'jan


Each week, Wah’du has tasked you with clearing out a specific chamber, and for your efforts, a reward of 1 Mythical Soul Fragment and 2,000 Undercoin. Have you missed a few weeks? No worries, Wah'du has you covered. He'll hand out each skipped quest, one after another, so you can wrap up several in a single visit and get right back on pace.

New to the Labyrinth of Kindo’jan?

If you've completed the campaign quests, the Labyrinth is already unlocked for you. If not, no problem! Head north of Amani Pass in Eversong Woods and pick up "The Long Way Around" from Liadrin, or travel to Tokka's Landing and accept "The Labyrinth" from Kul'amara the Fierce. Then, complete the Chamber of Rites with Valeera Sanguinar and speak with Kinduru to unlock the full Labyrinth for your entire Warband.

Once completed, follow Wah’du’s quests and clear only the chambers he sends you to, in the order he asks. Do that, and you’ll earn enough Mythical Soul Fragments to claim any two pieces of Myth 2/6 gear (your choice) from Wah’du, Servant of de Loa.

Join the celebration as World of Warcraft marks its 22nd Anniversary with a variety of activities and plenty of ways to earn currency to buy a wide range of items.

Where : Caverns of Time in Tanaris

contentHtml:
All Skyborne now get a 10% discount on mounts in WoW: Forever, regardless of reputation.

WoW: Forever Mount Guide


Article Update: Skyborne always gets a 10% discount now, regardless of reputation. The article has been updated.


With the release of WoW: Forever, players noticed that the Skyborne don't get a 10% discount with mount vendors. In yesterday's hotfixes, Blizzard mentioned this:
Blizzard
View Original
Fixed an issue preventing the Skyborne from being able to receive the Honored reputation 10% gold discount on their Apprentice and Journeyman Riding skills sold by Genn Fairweather on Zephras Isle.
While this seems to imply that Skyborne will now get the reputation discount for being Honored, the discount now seems to be active for all Skyborne. A character that is Friendly with the Windshapers still has the 10% discount for both the Rare and Epic mount skills. This likely means that it now gives a discount to all Skyborne, regardless of their faction reputation!

 


It's unknown if this is intended, but Skyborne can now enjoy a discounted mount!
